rows.text: You open your eyes, and a wave of heat stings your skin. You drag yourself out from the ruins of a house, surrounded by smoke, dust, and cinders. And fire... purple fire...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Not long ago, monsters known as "Demons From Beyond" descended from the sky. Mothers clutching their children fled screaming, while fathers wielding spears were severed at the waist. Ahatopia, your home, was invaded. And yet, the Phantasmoon merely watched from high above in silence, unmoved.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Suddenly, your fingertips brush against something. It is a blank mask, wearing a smile that isn't quite a smile. It is your ticket to the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: They say that masks choose their own masters. You don't know why its gaze fell upon you, but this mask has undeniably revealed your future, in which you will become a Supplicant, and perhaps even an Aeon. You will possess might, and with it, the authority to rewrite reality.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Begin the roll-call. Become a Supplicant. Then, change everything." A voice echoes from the depths of your heart. So, how will you use this power?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You quietly take an oath beneath the Phantasmoon, voicing your desires. And so, the final Phantasmoon Games of the Cindearth Age begins...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
